Is a subscription required for my Wired Floodlight Camera to work after the 30-day trial ends?
No. A subscription is not required for your Floodlight to work after the 30-day trial period. Without a subscription, you will continue to receive notifications when motion is detected and be able to view your Floodlight’s live video feed. However, a subscription is required to maintain premium features like Video Cloud Storage, Interactive Notifications, Video Object Detection, and more. Visit www.arlo.com/arlosecure for a full list of features that require a paid plan.

[Whatisthatvelvet] I'm not a sparky but if you have to ask that question it's best you leave the install to someone qualified
[Jackson] For the purposes of a security camera you probably don't want it plugged into a power point, because if you do then it can be unplugged, or worse still someone can potentially go to your meter box and cut the power without actually being seen on camera. You would want the thing hard wired and then the cable protected ideally.
A cable going to a power point though is the same as any power wire in so far as it has a positive, neutral and earth. So if you have a 240v powered device in there now this camera will work. It's worth mentioning that most security cameras run off DC so this only applies to this floodlight camera
